title: Term Life Insurance Acceleration Room and Terminal Illness Advances on Whole Life Insurance
content:
**Term Life Insurance — acceleration room.** The room available for a terminal illness acceleration on a term policy is worked out by one of three methods, according to the terminal illness advances already paid to the owner on an Ashgrove whole life policy (Whole Life Insurance activity history) and on this term policy. The product's maximum acceleration amount is 500000 on every tier.

| Advances on record | Acceleration room |
|---|---|
| The owner has terminal illness advances paid on an Ashgrove whole life policy | the product's maximum acceleration amount less the advances already paid on this policy and less those whole life advances |
| None on whole life, but advances already paid on this policy | the maximum less the advances on this policy |
| Neither | the maximum acceleration amount |

**Worked cases (hypothetical).**

- Whole life advances of 120000; no earlier advance on this term policy: room 500000 less nothing less 120000, which is 380000.
- No whole life advances; 50000 already advanced on this policy: room 450000.
- No advances anywhere: room 500000.

The whole life advances are the terminal illness advance entries on the owner's whole life policies' activity history, whenever paid.
